short: High thermoelectric performance at room temperature of n-typ
title: High thermoelectric performance at room temperature of n-type Mg3Bi2-based materials by Se doping

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: n-type Mg3Sb2-based thermoelectrics need high near-room-temperature ZT to rival n-Bi2Te3. Se doping on the Sb site should supply electrons and raise the electrical performance of Mg3.2Bi1.4Sb0.6.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/synthesis). Premises: Excess Mg is required for stable n-type Mg3Sb2-based conduction [37]

states.title: Structure state
states.head: All x are single-phase Mg3Sb2-type (P-3m1) with no impurity reflections detected by XRD. Se substitutes on Sb sites as an electron donor
states.detail: Absorbed: n7 (STR/phase/identity), n8 (STR/defect/point). Premises: Mg3Sb2 layered structure, space group P-3m1, Mg on two sites Mg(1), Mg(2)

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Se donor electrons lift E_F to a multi-valley conduction-band minimum (M, K, L), raising n without losing valley degeneracy. Hall carrier concentration rises from ~0.5e19 (x=0) to ~1.7-3.3e19 cm-3 at 300 K, increasing with x.
states.detail: Absorbed: n9 (MEC/pathway), n10 (PRP/descriptor), n11 (PRP/descriptor), n12 (PRP/value), n13 (PRP/value), n14 (PRP/value), n15 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Alloying Mg3Bi2 with Mg3Sb2 lowers kappa_L by alloy scattering [22]

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Room-temperature ZT reaches ~0.82-0.84 for x=0.005, the highest in the series at 300 K. Calculated leg conversion efficiency reaches ~12% for x=0.01 at Th=623 K, Tc=300 K

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Se is an effective n-type dopant for Mg3.2Bi1.4Sb0.6, giving RT ZT ~0.82, peak ZT ~1.24 and ~12% efficiency

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: With Se (panel d vs c), conduction-band minima at M, K and L drop from ~0.15 eV above E_F to E_F; Gamma CB stays ~0.35-0.4 eV up. In the Se-containing cell, conduction-band valleys at M, K and L lie at E_F (within ~0.05 eV); the Gamma CB minimum sits ~0.35-0.4 eV higher
nodes.solves: Se donor electrons lift E_F to a multi-valley conduction-band minimum (M, K, L), raising n without losing valley degeneracy
nodes.note: pixel-scaled reads: c M~0.15, K~0.15, L~0.17 eV; d M~0, K~0, L~0.05 eV. The state at E_F beside Gamma in c is the valence-band top (at ~-0.1 eV in d), not a CB valley valley energies read from the axis; k-point names are in-image labels. Linked text lists Gamma among the CBM valleys; F2d does not show a Gamma valley near E_F (text/figure conflict)
nodes.detail: o4: With Se (panel d vs c), conduction-band minima at M, K and L drop from ~0.15 eV above E_F to E_F; Gamma CB stays ~0.35-0.4 eV up; o5: In the Se-containing cell, conduction-band valleys at M, K and L lie at E_F (within ~0.05 eV); the Gamma CB minimum sits ~0.35-0.4 eV higher

nodes.title: evidence, F5
nodes.head: x=0 kappa_L+kappa_b (1.1-1.4) is ~0.4-0.6 above every Se-doped sample although its Bi/Sb ratio is the same
nodes.solves: Alloy scattering from Bi/Sb disorder in the Mg3Bi2-Mg3Sb2 solid solution lowers kappa_L
nodes.note: the kappa_L drop tracks Se doping, not Bi/Sb alloying; bipolar kappa_b in low-n x=0 or Se point-defect scattering are unweighed alternatives
nodes.detail: a1: x=0 kappa_L+kappa_b (1.1-1.4) is ~0.4-0.6 above every Se-doped sample although its Bi/Sb ratio is the same
nodes.inner_audit: a1: the kappa_L drop tracks Se doping, not Bi/Sb alloying; bipolar kappa_b in low-n x=0 or Se point-defect scattering are unweighed alternatives

nodes.title: evidence, F5, F6
nodes.head: ZT at 300 K: ~0.84 (x=0.005), ~0.78 (0.01), 0.63-0.69 (0.02-0.04); n-Bi2Te3 reference curve ~0.88. x=0.005, 300 K: S^2/rho ~25.8 vs plotted PF ~23; S^2T/(rho kappa) ~0.82 vs PF T/kappa ~0.74; x=0.01 gives ~0.82 vs 0.78
nodes.solves: Room-temperature ZT reaches ~0.82-0.84 for x=0.005, the highest in the series at 300 K
nodes.op: compare with reference value, cross check consistency, read characteristic point, replot derived series
nodes.note: text: ~0.82; n-Bi2Te3 Ref.8 dashed curve lies slightly above x=0.005 at 300 K judge pixel reads: F5a rho 22.5 (x=0.005), 11.8 (x=0.01) micro-ohm m; F5b S -241, -189; F5c PF 23.2, 28.8; F5d kappa 0.946, 1.11; F6a ZT 0.84, 0.78. F5c sits below S^2/rho for both (11% and 5%). The x=0.005 plotted ZT follows S^2/rho, the x=0.01 plotted ZT follows the plotted PF; computed consistently, x=0.005 and x=0.01 tie at ~0.82 (from S,rho) or x=0.01 leads (from plotted PF), so 'x=0.005 highest RT ZT' is not robust. The ~0.82 value itself is reproduced.

The ~0.82 value itself is reproduced.
